2007.why: It drew a bit more than the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about suspension.
2007.pln: a bit more than the average car's complaints
td: Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.

2008.why: It drew about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about suspension.
2008.pln: about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car
td: Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.

2009.why: It drew about one and a half times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about transmission & drivetrain.
2009.pln: about one and a half times the average car's complaints

Wheels
Look for bent or cracked wheels and listen for a hum or wobble at speed.
